units.source_text: 源氏公子回到私邸之后，躺在床上回想那个可爱的人儿，觉得非常留恋，便独自微笑。

en.t: After Prince Genji returned to his private residence, he lay on his bed thinking back on that lovely person. Feeling deeply reluctant to part from the memory, he smiled to himself.

units.source_text: 睡到日高三丈，方才醒来。

en.t: He slept until the sun was high in the sky, and only then did he wake.
He decided to write a letter to ask after Murasaki.

units.source_text: 但这信与寻常不同，时时搁笔寻思，好容易写成。

en.t: But this letter was unlike his usual ones. Again and again he set down his brush to think, and only with great effort did he finish writing it.
He also enclosed several beautiful pictures as a gift.
